title: Collection
description: Funds received (collected) from a mobile subscriber.

remote_transaction_id.description: Transaction ID from the mobile network operator.

organization.description: ID of the organization the collection was matched to.

amount.description: The collection amount. Decimal serialised as a string, e.g. "3000.0000".

phonenumber.description: Phone number the collection came from, international format.

reference.description: Reference the subscriber sent with the collection.

status.description: successful, failed, pending or cashed_out (filters also accept reversed, reversed_on_network, expired).

author.description: ID of the user who created the object.

modified.description: When the object was last modified (UTC).

updated_by.description: ID of the user who last updated the object.
